actions.action: Scrape the mold off the soil surface and dispose of it, avoiding breathing spores
Dry the compost in the sun
Improve drainage by repotting into a mix of compost with orchid bark, perlite, grit/sand
Alternatively switch to soil-free media like leca or Pon
Assess and improve light and air flow around the plant

verdict.reason: The answer correctly attributes the mold to damp conditions and includes changing to a better-draining mix, though this sits among several other suggestions like scraping, cinnamon and airflow, and nothing in it is harmful.
